text:
anika: Quick thread to finalize owners from the DB-connection-surge postmortem. I mapped actions but want secondaries + clear handoff if primary is OOO. Postmortem: https://redwood.company/postmortems/db-conn-surge-1950009000

tyler: I can own connection pool caps + client retries (item A). ETA 10 days. Will need a schema cross-check with app-team.

anika: @tyler awesome. Can you also add a rollback/fallback plan for the change?

tyler: yup, will include feature-flag + smoke tests.

vikram: I'll take the slow-query index work (item B) and the perf dashboard. ETA 1 week.

jess: I can update the incident runbook to reflect new triage steps and run the post-deploy checklist (item C). ETA 3 days.

anika: drafting a tiny RACI here, modify as needed: 
``
A: Pool caps & retry logic 1 R: tyler | A: platform-eng | C: app-team | I: oncall
B: Indexes & perf dashboard 1 R: vikram | A: db-eng | C: tyler | I: se-team
C: Runbook & deploy checklist 1 R: jess | A: ops | C: anika | I: pager-duty
```

tyler: split request 1 config change vs runtime rollout. I'll own config (RED-6278) and tag infra for runtime rollout (RED-6279).

ops-bot: Jira ticket created: RED-6278 (Pool caps & retries) by tyler

ops-bot: Jira ticket created: RED-6279 (Infra runtime rollout) by ops-bot

vikram: created RED-6280 for indexes + added sample EXPLAIN output and a repro script.

jess: created RED-6281 for runbook updates, included acceptance criteria and playbook snippet.

anika: please add secondaries on the tickets. Also add expected ready-by dates in ticket descriptions.

tyler: added @vikram as secondary on RED-6278 and put target date 1950019645 in the ticket.

vikram: added @jess as secondary on RED-6280.

jess: added @anika as secondary on RED-6281.

anika: one more ask 1 can we capture the recurring pattern check? this surge looks like weekly batch overlap + background backup. propose a weekly alert to detect backup+writes concurrency.

vikram: I'll add a Grafana panel and alert, query: `sum(rate(db_connections[5m])) by job` + backup flag join. will reference RED-6282 for monitoring.

ops-bot: Jira ticket created: RED-6282 (Monitoring for backup+write concurrency)

anika: thanks. final ownership table for the thread:  
- RED-6278 1 Pool caps & retries 1 tyler (R), vikram (secondary) 1 target 10 days (1950021200)  
- RED-6279 1 Infra runtime rollout 1 infra (A) 1 target 10 days  
- RED-6280 1 Index work & dashboard 1 vikram (R), jess (secondary) 1 target 1 week (1950019645)  
- RED-6281 1 Runbook & checklist 1 jess (R), anika (secondary) 1 target 3 days (1950013500)  
- RED-6282 1 Monitoring alert 1 vikram (R) 1 target 1 week

jess: ack. I'll push the runbook PR and link RED-6281 here.

tyler: will drop the feature-flag plan into RED-6278.

anika: wrapping up 1 owners + secondaries set, tickets created, RACI noted, monitoring ticket queued. ops-bot please nudge us 48h before targets.

ops-bot: Reminder created: 48h pre-target nudges for RED-6278, RED-6280, RED-6281 scheduled. Calendar: weekly remediation sync also updated.

vikram: thanks all, will post perf baselines in RED-6280.

anika: closing the loop here 1 will check status in weekly remediation sync, reopen thread if anything blocks :white_check_mark:
